summary: This short note records that President George H. W. Bush delivered the 1990 State of the Union address to a joint session of the 101st United States Congress. It gives only the speaker, audience, and date, with no details of the speech's content.
one_line: Summary of President George H. W. Bush's 1990 State of the Union address to the 101st Congress on January 31, 1990.
